translation: Chinese angelica (當歸), yellow wax (黃蠟, each one liang), sesame oil (麻油, four liang). Put the Chinese angelica into the oil and fry until scorched black, remove the dregs, then add the yellow wax, stir rapidly until melted, let cool, store in a porcelain vessel; when used, spread on old silk cloth and stick. One variant uses white wax. <ins>Reattachment Method (綴法)</ins> (for a severed ear, the same) Use human hair placed in a Yangcheng jar, sealed with salt clay, calcined, ground into powder; while urgent, dip the injured ear or nose in the medicine, place it back in its original position, and bind it firmly with soft cloth for effect.
